title: Client tasks can be cancelled, archived or deleted, each with a reason
description: A client task's ••• menu offers Cancel, Archive and Delete. Cancelled work leaves every open count and the performance figures; archived work leaves the lists and the board.
items: Team leaders and the manager can cancel, reopen, archive and restore
Only finished or cancelled tasks can be archived
Delete is the manager's or admin's: it lists what goes with the task, including logged hours, and asks you to type DELETE
Cancelling an approved request cancels its task too
A form with submissions or tasks can be force-deleted by the manager or admin, by typing DELETE
pending: Needs the P16 database updates applied before it works.
